# LYRAE-CLASS SCIENCE SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Medium
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-4
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Bananium
"A medium-size science vessel with two xenoarcheology labs and an anomaly generator."
[italic]Brought to you by BlueBird Starship Design & Construction.[/italic]
# GETTING THE MOST OUT OF THE LYRAE
- Customise your labs! Both labs are set up for xenoarcheology as standard, but consider changing them if you want to specialise. - Make use of the gas transfer systems in the labs to capture any valuable gases produced by artifacts. - The existing lattice and free space between the Lyrae's 'arms' are ideal space for storing artifacts or for expanding the ship itself. - Consider hiring a salvager to work with you for all your artifact and material needs! - The workshop has plenty of space for you to add new machines. - Remember to increase the power output of and upgrade the generator as you install more machines!
